name: CubePart
description: CubePart is an open-vocabulary, part-controllable 3D generative framework developed by Roblox, CMU, and Stanford (SIGGRAPH 2026). It synthesizes game-ready 3D objects decomposed into distinct, semantically labeled meshes matching a user-defined parts schema.
keyFeatures: Two-Stage Generative Pipeline (MM-DiT Global Denoiser + Part-Level Decoder)
Parts Schema Control Signal (e.g. [body, wheels, doors, engine])
Game-Ready Modular Asset Output for Roblox Studio, Unity, and Unreal
Built on VecSet Latent Shape Representation & Qwen-VL Conditioning
curatorNotes: Verified lab affiliation: Roblox Research, Carnegie Mellon University, and Stanford University. Presented at SIGGRAPH 2026. Code published in Roblox/cube repository and weights on HuggingFace under Roblox/cubepart.
